title: Comics in the Classroom
content: For any teacher considering using comics in the classroom,Teaching Degree.orghas assembled ahuge number of helpful resources, including benefits, resources, reading lists, lesson plans, manga & anime, and where to get free stuff.(Above, Andy Wales of Lynch-Bustin Elementary School in Athens, PA, a pioneer promoter of comics to schoolkids). His blog is "Panel Discussion".100 tips and tools for comics in the classroom,link.
